text:
How miraculous Nature is!

For does not snow give light? Immaculate

and mysterious, trembling and silent,

it seems to me that mutely it prays

as it falls... Oh snowfall!:

may your weightless and glacial eucharist

today absolve me of the sin of living

and make my soul, like you, become

fulgent, white, silent and cold.

translation.title: How Miraculous Nature Is!...
translation.editorial_note: This first-line version keeps the same snowy prayer and absolution.
